stack.tanstack_table: none (uses Nuxt UI's UTable, which wraps tanstack internally but not a direct dep)

local_reimplementations.name: SimpleTable
local_reimplementations.notes: thin wrapper around Nuxt UI's <UTable> (columns/rows/rowKey props, per-cell named slots via TableColumn). narduk-libs ships no table. UTable's own sort/pagination props (v-model:sorting, v-model:pagination) are NOT forwarded -- SimpleTable is a pure static-display wrapper today.

local_reimplementations.name: InventoryHistoryChart
local_reimplementations.notes: hand-rolled inline <svg> chart (line 206), no charting library at all -- narduk-charts is not even a dependency of this app (checked web/package.json), despite the catalog listing NardukLineChart/NardukHistogramChart as available. Largest single hand-rolled UI surface found in this repo.

local_reimplementations.name: DataState
local_reimplementations.notes: single component covering loading|error|empty via one `type` prop, wrapping Nuxt UI's UAlert. Highest-reuse non-table component in this repo. Plausible AppEmptyState overlap by purpose only -- not prop-compared.

table.server_api: GET /api/snapshots?limit=N (clamped 1-500, default 100, src/router.ts:65 + src/public-data.ts:48 -- bound SQL LIMIT, no page/cursor/sort); most table data comes from range-keyed cached JSON payloads (/api/public-history?range=, /api/reports), not a paged list endpoint
tests: tests/e2e/nuxt-pages.spec.ts (229 loc, generic hydration/marker-text smoke coverage only -- no table-specific sort/paginate/mobile assertions, unlike operator-portal)
table.notes: column_count/column_types sampled from RollupRegionTable.vue (its only distinct consumer configuration: region link, 4 money/number columns, signed-net styled cell). Row links exist here (NuxtLink in the region cell slot) but are caller-provided via slot, not a SimpleTable prop -- so 'row_link' is marked false at the component level. mobile='not measured': no CSS/breakpoint logic found in SimpleTable.vue itself in the time budget available; relies entirely on Nuxt UI's own UTable responsive behavior, unverified here.

filter_search_bar.notes: URL-link-based 7d/14d/30d range switcher, not a text search.
URL-link-based daily/weekly/monthly period nav, same shape as ReportRangeSwitcher.

status_chip_badge.notes: generic status badge; narduk-libs ships no equivalent.

empty_state.notes: also covers loading_state and error_state via one `type` prop -- see local_reimplementations.

page_header.notes: second-highest reuse component in the repo.

kpi_stat_tile.notes: plausibly overlaps narduk-ui's NsReadoutTile by purpose; not prop-compared.
grid-cols-4 layout composing 4 MetricTiles; not itself reused elsewhere, listed for completeness.

card_list.notes: despite the name, this is a searchable station LIST sidebar, not a map -- no maplibre/mapbox/leaflet/AppMapKit found anywhere in this app (narduk-mapkit-nuxt is not even a dependency).
zero consumers found by tag-grep (plain and kebab-case) -- appears to be dead/unused code, flagged not fixed (read-only survey).

chart_wrapper.notes: see local_reimplementations -- hand-rolled inline SVG, no charting library dependency at all.

top_extraction_candidates.name: SimpleTable
top_extraction_candidates.why: Smallest, cleanest table wrapper found across the lane's repos -- a thin, typed UTable adapter (columns/rows/rowKey + per-cell slots). Good evidence that a shared table built on Nuxt UI's UTable is viable and low-LOC when it doesn't hand-roll DOM/a11y itself (contrast with operator-portal's CollectionTable, which is real-<table>-first because Nuxt UI wasn't used).

top_extraction_candidates.name: InventoryHistoryChart
top_extraction_candidates.why: 277 lines of hand-rolled inline SVG charting in an app that has narduk-core/analytics/seo installed but not narduk-charts -- a concrete case where a shared chart component was available estate-wide and not adopted.

top_extraction_candidates.name: DataState
top_extraction_candidates.why: 10 consumers for 25 lines -- highest reuse density found in this repo, and unifies loading/error/empty into one component/prop, a pattern narduk-libs' AppEmptyState may not currently offer (unverified, L0's job).

notes: Two-part repo: `web/` is the Nuxt 4 app (surveyed here), root `src/` is the actual Cloudflare Worker/data API that `web/server/api/[...path].ts` proxies to -- the real list/limit contract lives in src/router.ts, not web/server. No layouts/ directory in the app at all. narduk-mapkit-nuxt and narduk-charts are NOT dependencies despite matching component needs (map sidebar, history chart) existing locally. No table/mobile/sort UI defects found in issue or PR history -- this app's table surface (SimpleTable, 8 consumers) has had no reported breakage, unlike operator-portal's pre-migration horizontal-scroll history.
